matched.description: The id of the ONE candidate whose defect is the same as the proposed issue's, e.g. "g2". Empty string when none of them is the same defect. An id that is not among the candidates shown is rejected.

evidence.description: The span of the CHOSEN candidate's opinion passage showing the court engaged with what that recorded sentence describes, copied EXACTLY from it, character for character, OCR damage included. This confirms the recorded sentence; it is not the comparison itself. Empty string only when matched is empty or determinable is false.

determinable.description: True if the passages contain enough to judge either way. False when they are cut mid-argument or otherwise give no basis to decide — in which case alignment must be 0.0.

alignment.description: How far the proposed issue and the CHOSEN candidate's recorded defect name the same defect. Two decimal places. 0.8-1.0 the same defect -- both point at the same words of the provision and make the same complaint about them; 0.5-0.8 same underlying problem framed differently; 0.2-0.5 related but a different specific defect; 0.0-0.2 unrelated. 0.0 whenever matched is empty.

reason.description: One or two sentences tying the comparison to the score: what the proposed issue names, what the chosen recorded defect names, and why those are or are not the same defect. Say so if the choice between two candidates was close.

words_at_issue.description: Before deciding: which words of the provision the PROPOSED ISSUE is about, and which words each candidate's recorded defect is about. Name the term, sentence, silence or cross-reference each one turns on, separately, in one or two sentences. Two defects pointing at different words are different defects however similar the complaints sound.
